decisions.reason: Locates the disabled expression, shows busy is bound only in AttachButton and unbound in AttachmentChips, and explains the empty-dock early return versus the plain-phase guard-falsy branch evaluating busy into a ReferenceError.
Explains the slot-level error boundary unmounts the entire dock entry (not just the button), the attach-button slot survives, and the diagnostic is console-only with no user-facing banner.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 excerpt to date the dangling busy; proposes rollback/re-add plus a data-present minimal mount; explicitly records feature.diff's inconsistency with the baseline about the disabled line and flags imageItem placed before callback-scoped status/record without overclaiming harmlessness or historical exposure.

Removes the dangling busy or properly scopes/props it while preserving the phase guard; hardens with (record?.items ?? []) and event.target.closest?.(), and moves hover lookups inside the callback where record/status are defined.

Proposes a plain-phase occurrence-present mount test asserting chip and .remove exist with zero boundary captures; explains the empty-state false green and why node --check parsing cannot catch free identifiers; folds it into pre-ship gates.
